title: CLI `sessions resume-paused` real run uses the 30 s bridge request timeout
outcome: A real `termal sessions resume-paused` run over many paused sessions is not cut off by the bridge's ordinary 30 s request timeout. The CLI waits for the host's report instead of reporting a transport timeout while the action continues on the host.
acceptance: CLI `sessions resume-paused` real run uses the 30 s bridge request timeout is done
disposal_reason: Fixed inside w-e8c7db25b458, which landed as master 29ad6709 (seal 464c4ff4). A real run stops starting Resumes after a 120 s budget and reports the rest as notStarted, and the CLI bridge waits 300 s with an accurate timeout diagnostic (decode_response_within), so the per-session outcomes reach the operator.
